title: Desktop installer that works: Next server inside Electron, runtime API URL, icons, auto-update
goal: Produce a Windows installer whose app actually opens its screens, talks to a configurable server address and can update itself.
why: desktop/electron/main.ts loads .next/server/app/index.html (not produced by a standalone build) and falls back to localhost:3000 with nothing serving it; electron-builder.yml packs .next/** without the standalone server and points icons at desktop/public/ which does not exist; publish owner is your-org; no electron-updater; NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is baked in at build (src/lib/api/config.ts); tray icon is empty.
newDependencies: electron-updater (desktop dependency, exact version pinned, MIT)
steps: Follow READINESS-PLAN 4.5 exactly. electron/next-server.ts: startNextServer({ serverDir }) finds a free port (net.createServer().listen(0, "127.0.0.1")), spawns process.execPath with env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, PORT, HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1, NODE_ENV=production running server.js, pipes output to app.getPath("logs")/next-server.log, polls GET /login until 200 (30 s timeout), returns { url, stop }. stop() uses taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F on Windows, SIGTERM elsewhere.

electron/main.ts: requestSingleInstanceLock; in production start the server from path.join(process.resourcesPath, "app-server", <relative path to server.js inside standalone; Next nests it under the workspace path, e.g. desktop/server.js — detect by searching for server.js at depth <= 3>) and loadURL(url); on failure show an error dialog with the log path; stop the server on before-quit and window-all-closed. Development keeps DEV_URL. Tray uses nativeImage.createFromPath(build-resources/icon.png).

electron/runtime-config.ts: apiUrl from userData/config.json, else electron/dist/build-config.json (written at build from TRAVELCRM_API_URL), else http://localhost:8787/api/v1. ipcMain.on("config:get") returns it synchronously; ipcMain.handle("config:setApiUrl") validates (http/https URL ending in /api/v1) and writes config.json then relaunches. preload.ts exposes window.travelcrmConfig = ipcRenderer.sendSync("config:get") and electronAPI.setApiUrl.

src/lib/api/config.ts: replace the API_BASE_URL constant with getApiBaseUrl() (window.travelcrmConfig?.apiUrl ?? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? default) and keep `export const API_BASE_URL` only as a deprecated getter-backed value if removing it breaks too much; update all 24 references (grep API_BASE_URL in desktop/src) to call getApiBaseUrl() at use time, not at module load. Avoid rendering the URL during SSR to prevent hydration mismatch (use it inside effects/handlers).
Login page: an "Advanced" disclosure with "Server address" visible only when window.electronAPI exists; saving calls setApiUrl.

scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs: after next build copy .next/static to .next/standalone/<app dir>/.next/static and public/ (if any) next to server.js. scripts/make-icons.mjs: render build-resources/icon.svg to build-resources/icon.png 1024x1024 with Playwright chromium (already installed for e2e), and 256 px tray png.

electron-builder.yml: directories.buildResources build-resources; files electron/dist/** and package.json only; extraResources [{ from: .next/standalone, to: app-server }]; win/mac/linux icon build-resources/icon.png; publish { provider: generic, url: ${env.TRAVELCRM_UPDATE_URL} } (remove github your-org). package.json: build:electron = next build && node scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json; build:desktop = npm run build:electron && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml.

electron/updater.ts: electron-updater autoUpdater with logger to file, checkForUpdates on start (skip when !app.isPackaged or TRAVELCRM_UPDATE_URL unset) and every 6 hours, downloaded -> notify renderer ("Restart to update") via ipc.

Playwright Electron smoke (desktop/playwright.electron.config.ts, testDir e2e-electron): installs release/*.exe silently with `/S /D=<tmp dir>` (NSIS), launches the installed exe with _electron.launch({ executablePath }) and env TRAVELCRM_API_URL pointing at the slot 1 API, writes config via the UI or config.json, logs in as admin@demo.com, sees the dashboard, then closes and asserts the next-server child exited (no process listening on the recorded port). Update check test: serve-update-feed.mjs serves a folder with a latest.yml declaring a higher version; the app logs "update-available" (read the log file).
tests: desktop/src/lib/api/config.test.ts: getApiBaseUrl prefers window.travelcrmConfig, then env, then default.
desktop/e2e-electron/smoke.spec.ts as described (installer, login, child process stops, update-available).
acceptance: `npm run build:desktop` produces release/TravelCRM Pro Setup <version>.exe on this machine.
The installed app logs in against a local API whose address was set at runtime.
Closing the app leaves no node/electron child listening.
Unit, typecheck and lint gates green; the web build used by fix-stack still works (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL path).
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8787/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/auth-shell.spec.ts e2e/itineraries.spec.ts e2e/settings-company.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: OV/EV code-signing certificate (Azure Trusted Signing is not open to Indian organisations per COST-MODEL); signed installer passes SmartScreen; update feed on R2 behind downloads.<domain>; macOS DMG on a Mac runner.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md: ds-* indigo tokens only (no raw palette classes or hex), archetypes (ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage or PageContainer + PageHeader), FilterBar + useInfiniteScroll for lists, RelationCombobox for relations, PhoneInput for phones, useConfirm instead of window.confirm, graceful degradation when an env key is missing. lint-gate must not rise for any file you touch.
fix-stack uses `next start` on the web build; keep `npm run build` (web) unchanged so the e2e harness keeps working.
electron-builder downloads NSIS and Electron binaries on first run (network). If the machine is offline, report it rather than vendoring binaries.
Install the new dependency in the main checkout only (orchestrator), never inside a worktree with junctioned node_modules.
R101 runs in parallel and does not touch desktop/; R113 later edits the login page: keep your login change small and isolated (one component).
